title: Sucrose Gradient Surface Isolation
author: Alexander Radaoui
materials: After all buffers are prepared, retrieve PDX/tumor samples or cells and thaw on ice. Add 1 tablet of Roche cOmplete ™ Protease Inhibitor Cocktail EASYpack per 50 mL of homogenization buffer. Vortex to dissolve tablet. For cells, aim to have roughly 100 million . For solid PDX tumor, aim to have between 250 and 350 milligrams .

steps.title: Initial Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Resuspend each sample in 10 mL of HOMOGENIZATION BUFFER in a 50 mL conical tube and dissociate tumor chunks using an electric TissueRuptor® II until the mixture is fully fluid and homogenous. Keep samples on ice throughout; autoclave stems before use and change stems between samples.

steps.title: Mechanical Filtration
steps.instruction: Pass the sample through needles of decreasing gauge to ensure complete homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Pass the sample through an 18-gauge needle into a second 50 mL conical tube at least once.
Pass the sample through a 22-gauge needle between the first and second 50 mL conical tubes 3 times.
If the syringe clogs at either stage, perform further electric homogenization.

steps.title: Post-Nuclear Cytosol (PNC) Isolation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the fully homogenized samples in 15 mL conicals at 1000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes. Collect the supernatant (PNC) in a new 15 mL conical and keep on ice.

steps.title: Crude Plasma Membrane (CPM) Isolation
steps.instruction: Prepare a sucrose cushion and centrifuge to isolate the CPM fraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 60% sucrose as a cushion to Beckman Coulter® Ultra-Clear Centrifuge Tubes using a P-1000.
Very slowly layer 2 mL of PNC supernatant on top of the 60% sucrose cushion (e.g., using a serological pipette).
Balance opposite rotor samples to the 100th decimal with homogenization buffer.
Centrifuge at 100,000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 hour.
Carefully remove ~75% of the homogenization buffer supernatant using a serological pipette without disturbing the protein layer.
Harvest the CPM fraction from the top of the 60% sucrose cushion using a P-200 (swirling technique) and transfer to a new ultra-clear centrifuge tube, minimizing 60% sucrose carry-over.

steps.title: Enriched Plasma Membrane (EPM) Isolation
steps.instruction: Create a multi-step sucrose gradient to further enrich the plasma membrane.

substeps.instruction: Using a P-1000 (set to 750 uL), slowly layer 1.5 mL of each sucrose concentration in a 'tear drop' fashion in the following order: 42.8%, 42.3%, 41.8%, 41.0%, 39.0%, and 37.0%.
Fill the remainder of the tubes slowly and balance opposite samples to the 100th decimal with 37% sucrose.
Centrifuge at 100,000 x g, 4 °C, overnight (minimum 18 hours).
Recover the EPM fraction from the top of the 37% sucrose cushion using a P-200 (swirling technique) and transfer to a new ultra-clear centrifuge tube, limiting 37% sucrose carry-over.

steps.title: EPM Pellet Sedimentation
steps.instruction: Pellet the EPM fraction using HEPES buffer.

substeps.instruction: Fill ultra-tubes with HEPES BUFFER and balance opposing tubes to the 100th decimal.
Centrifuge at 150,000 x g, 4 °C, for a minimum of 2.5 hours (up to 5 hours may be required to guarantee total pellet sedimentation).
Decant the HEPES supernatant carefully.

steps.title: Protein Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and prepare for digestion.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 400 uL of DIGESTION BUFFER (10% SDC + 100 mM NH4HCO3) and vortex.
If pellets do not solvate well, sonicate on ice for 10 minutes.
Perform a BCA Assay or other protein quantification to determine concentration for trypsin dosing.
Samples may be stored at -80 °C after resuspension if digestion is not immediate.

steps.title: Protein Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind proteins to Amicon® 0.5 mL Centrifugal Filter Units (up to 10 KDa).

substeps.instruction: Apply samples to the filter and spin at 8,000 to 12,000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Decant flow-through waste.
Wash filters twice with 400 uL of ddH2O, spinning at 8,000 to 12,000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes each time; decant waste after each wash.

steps.title: Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Reduce disulfide bonds and block them via alkylation.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 uL of 5 mM Dithiothreitol (DTT) in 50 mM NH4HCO3 to the filter unit; incubate at room temperature for 1 hour. Do not spin down.
Add 16.67 uL of 0.5 M Iodoacetamide (IAA, made fresh with ddH2O) per 400 uL sample using a P-20 to the filter unit.
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Spin down at 12,000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 to 15 minutes and decant waste.

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins into peptides using trypsin.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 400 uL solution of 50 mM NH4HCO3 containing trypsin at a ratio of 1 ug trypsin per 20 ug of protein.
Add the trypsin solution to the sample and incubate overnight at room temperature.
Verify the solution is at pH 8 for optimal activity.

steps.title: Peptide Recovery and Acidification
steps.instruction: Recover peptides and acidify to promote C-18 binding.

substeps.instruction: Lightly resuspend the filter solution with a P-200.
Place the filter upside-down into a new centrifuge tube and spin at 12,000 x g, 4 °C, for 2 minutes.
In a fume hood, add 3-5 uL of LC/MS-Grade Trifluoroacetic Acid (TFA) to reach pH 2.
Incubate on the bench at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Spin down at maximum speed, 4 °C, for 15 minutes.

steps.title: C-18 Stage Tipping and Purification
steps.instruction: Purify peptides using C-18 resin stage tips.

substeps.instruction: Pack P-200 pipette tips with 4-6 punches of C-18 resin (using snipped P-1000 tips) and place in eppendorf tubes.
Wash stage tips with 100 uL of 100% Acetonitrile; spin at 2,000 x g for 2 minutes and decant.
Wash stage tips with 100 uL of 0.1% TFA (in ddH2O); spin at 2,000 x g for 2 minutes and decant.
Load the sample onto the stage tip; spin at 2,000 x g for 1 minute and decant.
Wash samples with 100 uL of 0.1% TFA; spin at 2,000 x g for 2 minutes and decant.
Elute samples into fresh eppendorf tubes using 100 uL of 70% Acetonitrile; centrifuge at 1,500 x g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Drying and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry the purified peptides and store for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in a speed vacuum to dry for 2-6 hours.
Freeze dried samples at -20 °C until mass spectrometry analysis.
